name: Lola Marie Loud
source:
Lola is [url=https://vndb.org/c151348]Lana[/url]'s twin, and her opposite, but best friend. Where Lana loves to play in the dirt, and literally comb through garbage, Lola is prim, proper, and a princess in every single way. Lola got interested in Beauty pageants at a young age, and [url=https://vndb.org/c151352]Mom[/url] started taking her to them as soon as she could walk. She's got a ton of trophies to her name.

She can charm anyone with her Princess act and sweet adorableness... but don't let that fool you! Lola is one of my most dangerous sisters! Underneath that ‘lady like' behavior she has a ruthless and cunning mind that never forgets a slight! She even scares [url=https://vndb.org/c151346]Lori[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c151350]Lucy[/url] sometimes with how evil and merciless she can be!

But as long as you stay on her good side, Lola can be a downright sweetheart. She knows she's beautiful but she doesn't let it get to her head. She's not a bully or a mean girl by any stretch. She spends most of the year being homeschooled so she can prepare for her Pageants.

[In game description]
